To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) parental feeding style and physical activity are the two most important parental variables associated with obesity, 2) the majority of studies on parental feeding style have shown an association between the use of pressure feeding, restriction and control, and the child's weight status, 3) the use of pressure and restriction feeding styles is more prevalent among parents of overweight children, 4) parents of obese children are more likely to use control feeding style
parental neglect of feeding and physical activity in obese individuals has been reviewed.
the Saudi parents have a tendency to use more controlling feeding style, less authoritative style, and less physical activity with their kids, which are all associated with obesity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of parental neglect of feeding and its association with obesity.
the parental role in the development of childhood obesity.
the parental feeding style and physical activity as a preventive measure for obesity in Saudi Arabia.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the parental feeding styles and the physical activity are 2 variables that are highly correlated with childhood obesity, and that these 2 factors are interrelated and should not be studied separately.
the parental neglect of feeding is the major factor in the development of obesity.
the feeding style of Saudi parents and the level of physical activity of their children are in need of a thorough investigation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
parental feeding style is the most important factor in the development of child’s eating behaviors and the child’s weight status.
parental neglect of feeding and physical activity is a major factor in obesity.
the parental feeding practices and the physical activity are the most important variables in the prevention of childhood obesity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
parental neglect is a serious issue and should be addressed in the Saudi society.
the feeding style and physical activity are the most important parental variables that could be used to reduce childhood obesity.
the feeding practices and the physical activity are the 2 most influential parental factors that could be modified to prevent the onset of obesity in the future generations.
